description: Electronics Engineering student (UNAL, Colombia). My idea for this track: derive CO2, CO and H2O production rates of comets directly from SPHEREx Level-2 spectral images (spectral WCS, static-sky subtraction, band fitting, Haser model) and publish them in an interactive web app. Looking for strong technical profiles: scientific Python (astropy/numpy), signal processing or statistics, astronomy/physics, and frontend (React/TypeScript, WebGL/D3). Rigor first.
